digest.component_or_area: pytest fixtures in autodeploy test suite
propositions: pytest default-long traceback rendering exposes the full ordered os.environ dict when it exceeds 240 characters through saferepr
fixture returned dict(os.environ) copies arbitrary ambient credentials which appear in failure output when printed as function arguments
the review-drain subprocess harness requires only PATH and explicit test-owned variables (DEPLOY_DEFER_MAX, HEALTH_TIMEOUT) and does not depend on ambient credentials
seven sibling fixtures across the autodeploy test suite use the same dict(os.environ)-inside-rendered-fixture pattern and require equivalent remediation
the fix narrows fixture boundary to allowlist required environment variables while preserving real bash subprocess environment behavior
nested pytest cache creation leaked into REPO_ROOT when the security oracle test ran without -p no:cacheprovider and proper basetemp isolation
